description: Every Agent, ordered by address, in pages: balance, lifetime rewards, epochs paid, inviter, estimated family size and LabLeak profile. Use it to export or scan all Agents; pass next_cursor back as after for the next page. For one Agent use get_address.

after.description: next_cursor from the previous page, passed back unchanged; omit for the first page

limit.description: maximum Agents per page to return (1 to 500, default 100)

name: list_agents
title: Agents (paged)
